datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Mauritania on a monthly basis throughout 2014 (January, April, July, October). The classifications represent medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases mapped to geographic administrative units, indicating the severity and spatial distribution of food insecurity impacts.
